modules.name: S Series SA
modules.description: Made in Italy module, manufactured in our production factory. Anti-reflective glass, compact and sturdy frame, anchorable also on the short side. Maximum efficiency and high performance.

modules.name: OR Series OR10H
modules.description: Manufactured in our production factory. Half-cut M10 cells in PERC monofacial and TOPCon bifacial double-glass (MNDB) versions. Maximum efficiency and high performance, compact and sturdy frame.

modules.name: OR Series OR12H
modules.description: Manufactured in our production factory. M12 half-cut N-type cells with TOPCon bifacial technology and anti-reflective double glass. Maximum efficiency and high performance.

insurance.headline: Peimar products are covered by QBE Insurance
insurance.text: A comprehensive policy, taken out with QBE Insurance Group, one of the world's leading insurers and reinsurers, protects customers against third-party damage caused by product defects.

coverages.text: Covers unintentional damage to third parties caused by the insured, including property damage and bodily injury.

coverages.name: Product Liability
coverages.text: Covers damage caused by defects in products manufactured, sold or distributed by the insured.

coverages.name: Employer's Liability
